output.objection: I will not accept a manual step for contract validation because it breaks the pipeline stability we are trying to build. You cannot rely on a human to check every data schema change before the nightly forecast runs.
output.correction: You misread my concern as a preference for speed when it is actually about removing a single point of failure. I am asking for automated enforcement so the infrastructure does not depend on someone remembering to run a check.
